roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and compliance within our compassionate environment.In this dual-focused position, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive staff training programs, fostering continuous professional growth, and leading our infection control initiatives. Your expertise will ensure adherence to all regulatory guidelines, protect our residents and staff, and maintain a safe and healthy community. This is an urgent opening, offering a competitive hourly rate.If you are a proactive RN with a passion for education and a commitment to infection control, we invite you to apply. Join a team that values your contributions and supports your professional development.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Maryland.
Proven experience in staff development, nursing education, or a similar role.
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control within a healthcare setting.
Thorough understanding of state and federal regulations pertaining to skilled nursing facilities.
Exceptional communication, organizational, and leadership abilities.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, based on experience.

description:
Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL, as a Per Diem (PRN) Physical Therapist. This role offers the flexibility to work on an as-needed basis, providing essential therapy services to patients recovering from illness, injury, or surgery. You will play a crucial part in helping individuals regain their independence and improve their quality of life through personalized treatment plans.

We are seeking a compassionate and skilled Physical Therapist who thrives in a dynamic environment. This is an excellent opportunity for a professional looking to balance work with other commitments while making a significant impact on patient outcomes. If you are passionate about rehabilitation and eager to contribute your expertise, we encourage you to apply.

This PRN position allows you to maintain a flexible schedule while working alongside a supportive team committed to patient-centered care. Leverage your skills to provide high-quality therapy and support our mission of restoring health and mobility.
requirements: Current and valid Physical Therapist (PT) license in Florida
Experience working in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility
Ability to provide comprehensive physical therapy assessments and treatments
Commitment to patient-centered care and interdisciplinary teamwork

description:
We are urgently seeking dedicated Certified Occupational Therapy Assistants (COTAs) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL. This full-time role offers a vital opportunity to contribute to patient recovery and well-being within a supportive environment. You will play a key role in implementing individualized treatment plans under the supervision of an Occupational Therapist, helping patients regain independence and improve their quality of life.

As a COTA, you will assist patients with therapeutic activities, document progress, and educate both patients and their families on techniques for daily living. This is a critical opening, and we are looking for passionate professionals ready to make an immediate impact.
requirements: Current COTA certification and Florida state licensure
Experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility setting
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate for Certified Occupational Therapy Assistants (COTAs) is $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.
